svg.title: Barossa / Eden Valley (SA) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Barossa Valley; 2: Eden Valley; 3: Marananga; 4: Seppeltsfield; 5: Keyneton; 6: Pewsey Vale; 7: Angaston; 8: Nain; 9: Adelaide; 10: Gawler

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
